objective_semantics.reported_identity: Exact mathematical identity for actual rounded saved H0/H1, lambda0/lambda1 and finite-norm vectors; reproduces stored lambda difference and cannot recover information already lost by lambda storage or EOL averaging.
objective_semantics.quotient_candidate: Continuous normalized Rayleigh-quotient EOL of actual retained signed vectors; must be distinguished from reported finite lambdas and bound against the same eigenvalue objective before any optimizer use. No silent objective switch.
objective_semantics.rounding: Extended precision, math.fsum and a small residual gate alone are not a rigorous near-roundoff decrement bound. Independently bound radial/response arithmetic, finite eigensolver error, H assembly, CI norm/Gram, orbital reconstruction/constraint defect and filtered-gradient discrepancy.
objective_semantics.armijo: Original coefficient1e-4 and original gradient/metric preserved. If using a bound-aware callback, acceptance requires certified delta_upper <= existing Armijo RHS. None means unsupported scope; numerically unresolved cannot silently fall back to a rounding-prone favorable subtraction.
